commands.stdout:
usage: verify_distribution.py [-h] --repo REPO --source-manifest
                              SOURCE_MANIFEST --sdist SDIST --wheel WHEEL
                              --expected-managed EXPECTED_MANAGED --receipt
                              RECEIPT --profile {base,dev,api,cpu,cache-probe}
                              [--archives-only]

Verifica stdlib S/archivi/installazione; non importa né ripara il prodotto.
Receipt I/E schema1: envelope canonico del produttore S, kind, scope, source
(ID e SHA file), snapshot, archives, interpreter, profile, inputs, argv/cwd,
status. E richiede inoltre installation (ID/SHA della receipt I verificata).
Ogni consumer deve chiamare validate_receipt prima di collection/import. Le
prove reali degli import appartengono a V3–V5, dopo questo gate.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo REPO
  --source-manifest SOURCE_MANIFEST
  --sdist SDIST
  --wheel WHEEL
  --expected-managed EXPECTED_MANAGED
  --receipt RECEIPT
  --profile {base,dev,api,cpu,cache-probe}
  --archives-only

verify_distribution_scope: derived from S; no standalone flag
mode: RUN_TEST_MODE required to select Docker; pytest flag alone unsupported
